fields.title: 📖 Ibn Masʿūd: Bribery in judgment is Kufr
fields.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Masʿūd:**

> ***“When Ibn Masʿūd was asked about bribery, he said: It belongs to as-suḥt. When it was asked: And in judgment? he said: That is al-Kufr. Then he recited: Whoever does not judge according to what Allah has sent down.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Bribery in judgment is a tremendous sin and can be called Kufr; yet the Salaf explained at the same time that not every designation as Kufr is automatically Kufr Akbar.

immutable.source: 📝 Ibn Kathīr, Tafsīr zu Sūrah al-Māʾidah 5:44; aṭ-Ṭabarī, Jāmiʿ al-Bayān, Tafsīr zu 5:44.
